transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having these times after long days at work, or after a neighborhood meeting, where I come home and eat a lot more than I meant to. Just whatever’s around—leftovers, cereal, chips—and I keep going until I feel really uncomfortably full. It’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should bring it up.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah… I think so. Once I start on those evenings, it’s like I’m kind of on autopilot. I’ll tell myself I need to stop, especially if I’ve got an early crew start, but then I still end up going back to the kitchen for more.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these eating episodes?
I don’t know… maybe a little embarrassed, I guess. I try not to think about it too much afterward.
Do these episodes of eating a lot more than you meant to happen when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset, or can they happen at any time?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close enough attention to say. It’s… maybe after tougher days, but I don’t know if that’s always the reason.
Do you remember everything you eat during those episodes, or are there times when you don't recall eating something until later?
I don’t think so… I mean, I usually have a general idea of what I ate. I haven’t really noticed finding out later that I ate something and didn’t remember it.
Do you feel like you have no control over your eating during those episodes?

Yeah… I guess so. Once I start on those evenings, it kind of feels like I’m on autopilot. I’ll tell myself to stop, especially if I’ve got an early crew start, but then I still end up going back to the kitchen for more.
Do you ever feel like you're not really aware of what you're eating or doing while you're eating during these episodes?
I don’t know… not exactly. I’m aware enough, I think. It’s more like I’m not stopping myself, not that I don’t know what I’m doing.
Do you feel better or more relaxed after these episodes of eating a lot?
Maybe for a little bit… like it’s quiet for a minute. I don’t know if I’d call it better. It usually doesn’t last.
Do you usually feel hungry before these episodes of eating a lot?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid that much attention to whether I’m actually hungry beforehand.
Are you usually hungry before these episodes of eating a lot?
I guess I already sort of said… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed if it’s hunger exactly.
Do you ever find food missing or evidence that you've eaten without remembering it?
No… I don’t think so. I usually remember when I’ve eaten, even if I don’t really want to think about it.
Do you ever eat something during one of these episodes and then later have no memory of eating it?
No, I don’t think so. I remember eating it… even if I don’t really like thinking about it afterward.
Do you find that you're eating very quickly during these episodes?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid attention to the speed, I guess.
Do you find that you're eating very quickly during these episodes?
I still don’t really know. I haven’t noticed whether it’s fast or not… I’m usually just not paying attention to that.
Do you feel like you're unable to control what you're eating during these episodes because you're eating in response to an emotion, or is it more that you just can't seem to stop once you've started?
More like… once I’ve started, I can’t seem to stop. I’ll tell myself I need to stop because I’ve got an early crew start, but then I’m back in the kitchen anyway. It kind of feels like autopilot.
Do you ever find that you've eaten something during one of these episodes but can't remember how it tasted or what it was like while you were eating it?

I don’t really remember the taste much. It’s more like… once I start, I’m kind of on autopilot. I’ll tell myself to stop because I’ve got an early crew start, but then I still end up back in the kitchen.
Do you feel like you're aware of the taste or texture of the food while you're eating during these episodes?
Not really sure. I don’t think I’m paying much attention to that in the moment… it’s kind of hard to say.
Do you feel like you're completely aware of your actions while eating during these episodes?
Not completely, no. I mean, I know I’m doing it, but it feels kind of automatic… like I’ll tell myself to stop because I’ve got an early crew start, and then I’m still going back for more.
Do you think you usually start eating a lot during these episodes because you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
I don’t know. I mean… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern with that.
Do you ever eat something during one of these episodes and then later have no memory of what you ate?
I don’t think so. I mean, I might not remember every little thing clearly, but I don’t usually have, like, a total blank about what I ate.
